short_scenes.narration: Mesh and nodal give the same answers. So why learn both?
Nodal analysis uses node voltages and KCL. Here it gives six and three volts, the same answers as mesh.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Pick one point as zero volts. Find the voltage at every other junction using KCL. Once you know the voltages, every current is just Ohm's law.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Many parallel paths: nodal. Long loops: mesh. Less work, fewer mistakes.
